title: 'Grey's Anatomy' star Eric Dane dies at 53 after ALS battle
summary: Eric Dane, an actor known for roles in ‘Grey’s Anatomy’ and ‘Euphoria,’ died on Thursday at 53 from amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, his representatives said. Dane, who disclosed his diagnosis less than a year ago, spent his final days with family and became an advocate for ALS awareness in recent months.
